Actual Article Body:
HOUSTON — Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX) is keeping his powder dry from talk of a 2028 White House run as he campaigns for GOP colleagues on the ballot in the Nov. 3 midterm elections, but that could soon change.

The two-term senator and 2016 presidential candidate told the Washington Examiner in an interview Monday that while he’s not ready to make any announcements about another potential campaign, “that conversation is coming.”
